assumptions.choice: Implement a single 52-week trading run starting from data commencement.
assumptions.reason: The specification calls for selecting 50 random start dates and averaging metrics across separate backtests, which requires multi-run harness orchestration outside a single bt.Strategy class execution model.

assumptions.choice: Track week transitions using ISO calendar week tuples (iso_year, iso_week) on daily data.
assumptions.reason: The execution environment provides daily OHLCV bars; tracking ISO calendar week changes accurately measures 12-week rebalance intervals and the 52-week exit threshold without data resampling.

assumptions.choice: Calculate buy order size using 99.8% of available cash divided by current close price.
assumptions.reason: Ensures full portfolio target allocation (100%) while maintaining a minor buffer for 0.1% transaction commissions and next-bar execution price changes to prevent margin rejections.
